faqs.question: What are Multani tiles?
faqs.answer: A general name in Pakistan for traditional clay-based tiles linked to Multan, also used for blue-and-white glazed decorative tiles. There is no single standard, so define the exact tile before comparing prices.

faqs.question: How much do Multani tiles cost per square foot?
faqs.answer: We do not publish a fixed rate because it depends on type, size, finish, quantity and freight. Send your details on WhatsApp for a written, dated quote with the unit stated.

faqs.question: Multani tiles or terracotta: which should I choose?
faqs.answer: Plain terracotta suits warm earthy floors, while glazed decorative tiles suit feature walls. Glazed tiles can be slippery when wet, so check grip for floors.

faqs.question: Can Multani tiles be used outdoors?
faqs.answer: Sometimes. Fired clay is porous and needs a sloped base, drainage and a suitable sealer, and glazed surfaces need a grip check. Ask the maker about your specific tile and location.
